# Fidelity

Two parts: the **parity checklist** (per feature, hand-written; Complete = every row passes) and the
**fidelity ledger** (per exe function, generated by `slr-ledger` from address annotations and local test results;
see ADR 0004, 0008, 0009). Status: **nothing in the exact port passes yet.** The playable game in
`slr-core`/`slr-game` is the old approximation; it is deleted at headless boot (plan M1-14).

## Parity checklist (stock single-player)

Status values: `open` → `passing (oracle: <which>)`. Tiers: see ADR 0009.

| # | Feature | Tier(s) | Milestones | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P01 | Boot, intro (absent intro video behaves as the exe does), main menu | B, D | M1, M5 | open |
| P02 | Options and config persistence (video, sound, controls, `save/game/options`) | B, D, E | M5, M6, M7 | open |
| P03 | New career / load / save career (SDAT) | B, E | M7 | open |
| P04 | Car dealer (new cars) | B, D | M1, M5 | open |
| P05 | Used-car lot | B, D | M1, M5 | open |
| P06 | Garage: car view, part slot tree, install/remove parts | B, C, D | M3, M5 | open |
| P07 | Part catalog and purchasing | B, D | M1, M5 | open |
| P08 | Tuning (all stock tunable parameters) | B, C | M3 | open |
| P09 | Painter and decals | B, D | M4, M5 | open |
| P10 | Dyno | B, C | M3 | open |
| P11 | Day street races in the city | B, C, D | M3, M4, M5 | open |
| P12 | Night club drags | B, C, D | M3, M4, M5 | open |
| P13 | Pink-slip races | B, C, E | M3, M7 | open |
| P14 | Police (chase, fines, consequences) | B, C | M4 | open |
| P15 | Race of Champions on ROC_track (8 stock ROC opponents) | B, C, D | M3, M4, M5 | open |
| P16 | Quick race | B, C, D | M3, M5 | open |
| P17 | Free ride: city | B, C, D | M3, M4, M5 | open |
| P18 | Free ride: city2 | B, C, D | M3, M4, M5 | open |
| P19 | Free ride: ROC_track | B, C, D | M3, M5 | open |
| P20 | Free ride: test_track | B, C, D | M3, M5 | open |
| P21 | Traffic | B, C | M4 | open |
| P22 | Pedestrians | B, D | M4 | open |
| P23 | Day/night, sky, fog | D | M5 | open |
| P24 | Damage and wear (mechanical and visual) | B, C, D | M3, M5 | open |
| P25 | All 24 racer models drivable | C | M3 | open |
| P26 | All stock parts installable with their effects | B, C | M3 | open |
| P27 | Cameras and HUD/OSD | B, D | M5 | open |
| P28 | Engine and world sound, music | D | M6 | open |
| P29 | Keyboard, mouse and gamepad/wheel controls (ControlSet) | D | M6 | open |
| P30 | In-game video that ships (`Prime.avi`) | D | M5 | open |

Out of scope: mods, multiplayer (stock has none), the unreadable old-format `system/Scripts/render/osd/Dialog.class`,
the script compiler (stock ships no sources), force feedback, Windows/Linux.

## Intentional divergences

| Exe function | What differs | Why | Trigger inputs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FUN_00401480` (CD check), `texture.dat` | not ported; `stock/` checksum instead | no disc on macOS | always |

Original bugs (Proofix list, build 936) are added here as each one is confirmed in build 606 and fixed (plan M7-03).
